model_card.summary: A risk prediction model for cardiovascular disease using EHR data. Outputs a 0–100 risk score to support clinical decision-making.
model_card.intended_use_and_workflow: Used in clinical decision support to flag high-risk patients for follow-up. Integrates with Epic and Cerner EHRs.
model_card.how_to_use: Upload patient demographics and lab results via API or EHR integration. Review risk score and recommended actions in the dashboard.
model_card.targeted_patient_population: Adults 18+ with at least one cardiovascular risk factor
model_card.cautioned_out_of_scope_settings: Not for pediatric use. Not validated for emergency or acute care settings.
model_card.known_risks_and_limitations: May underperform on rare conditions. Performance not validated on non-English-speaking populations.
model_card.known_biases_or_ethical_considerations: Trained on US data; may have bias toward majority populations. Ongoing fairness monitoring.
model_card.output_and_input_data_types: Structured clinical data, numeric risk score
model_card.development_data_characterization: Retrospective dataset from 50 US health systems, 2018–2024
model_card.security: Data encrypted at rest and in transit. SOC 2 Type II.
model_card.transparency: Model card and evaluation reports publicly available.
model_card.stakeholders_consulted: Cardiologists, primary care physicians, patient advocates
model_card.bibliography: Chen et al. (2026). Cardiovascular Risk Prediction in Clinical Practice. Journal of Clinical AI.

safety.metric_goal: No critical failures in safety audit
